description: Sync entries, and pending task text on them, from the Contentful spaces you choose. Contentful permissions are not imported.
opening: Sync the entries of the Contentful spaces you select, from every environment of each space. Each entry in each environment is one document, with its text fields written as labelled lines. Task text on an entry is its own document, linked to the entry.

Contentful permissions are not imported, so every synced entry is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Only one language is kept for each field, English (en-US) first. Assets, reference fields and authors are not synced, and entries deleted in Contentful stay in HydraDB.

connect.auth: Contentful uses a Content Management API token.

credentials.name: api_token
credentials.text: A Contentful Content Management API token.

credentials.name: space_id
credentials.text: The id of a Contentful space. Required, but the spaces synced are the ones you select. A space named here and not selected is not synced.

steps.title: Create a token
steps.text: In Contentful, create a Content Management API token.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the token as `api_token` and enter a space id as `space_id`.

steps.title: Select spaces
steps.text: HydraDB lists the spaces the token can reach. Select the spaces to sync. To reach entries older than 30 days, raise `lookback_days` when you select them.

connect.account: One connector reads the spaces one Content Management API token can reach.

sync.first_sync: Each selected space reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the entries and tasks updated since the last sync.
sync.edits: An edited entry is read again and replaces its document.
sync.deletes: Deleted entries and tasks are not removed. They stay searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: updated_at
shared_attributes.text: When the entry or task was last updated, written as the `Updated` line. Sets an entry's result date, and a task's when it has no creation time.

shared_attributes.name: additional_metadata.contentful_entry_id
shared_attributes.text: The entry id. On an entry, picks out that entry. On a task, the entry it is on, so one key finds an entry and its tasks. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's items. Not searchable.

shared_attributes.name: space_id
shared_attributes.text: The space id. Keeps items from different spaces apart. There is no filter on it.

shared_attributes.name: environment_id
shared_attributes.text: The environment id, often `master`. Keeps the same entry in different environments apart. There is no filter on it.

documents.name: Entries
documents.title: The first non-empty text in the entry's `title`, `name`, `heading` or `slug` field, checking en-US first and then other languages alphabetically. An entry with none is titled `Contentful entry` and its id.
documents.text: The entry's text fields as labelled lines: `title`, `name`, `heading` and `slug` first, then other fields alphabetically. Each field uses its first non-empty value, en-US first, then other languages alphabetically. Rich text is flattened, and links keep their URLs in brackets. Numbers, true or false values and lists of text are included. Reference fields and embedded entries or assets are left out. If no field has text, the title stands in.
documents.date: When the entry was last updated, else when it was created.
documents.link_back: Opens the entry's editor page in the Contentful web app.
documents.files: None. Assets, such as images and files, are not synced.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the entry was created. Sets the result date only when the update time is missing. Not searchable.

documents.name: Tasks
documents.one_document: One task on an entry. Tasks come from Contentful's pending-task list for the token, not from a complete task history. Tasks with no text are skipped.
documents.title: `Contentful task` and the task id.
documents.text: The task text, with `Created`, `Updated` and `Parent` lines.
documents.date: When the task was created, else when it was last updated.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the task was created, written as the `Created` line. Sets the result date.

attributes.name: parent_id
attributes.text: The entry the task is on, written as the `Parent` line. Links the task to its entry.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.contentful_task_id
attributes.text: The task id. Picks out one task. Not searchable.

attributes.name: status
attributes.text: `active` or `resolved`. A query cannot match or filter on it.

example_searches: What does our Pricing FAQ entry say about enterprise discounts?
Which blog post entries mention the 2026 conference?
What task text is attached to the homepage hero entry?

connections: A task to the entry it is on.
Entries are not linked to the entries or assets they reference.
No links to items in other tools.
people: No people are attached. No author, assignee or editor is recorded.
graph.from_text: The entry's text fields and the task text.

not_synced: Entries last updated before the `lookback_days` window on the first sync.
Assets, such as images and files, and their text.
Values of reference fields that point to other entries or assets.
Other languages of a field once one language has a value.
Deletions: deleted entries stay in HydraDB.
